title: PRE-RAID: SHARP MAP NAMES, A QUIET SELECTED STATE, ROWS THAT FILL THE PACK, A SMALLER ASCEND PLATE
why: The second critic pass (still 3) said the lime accent appeared in five places at the same strength, the map labels were blurry and oversized, the pack rows left a dead gap and spaced unevenly, and the warning outline fought the ascend plate. The canvas is drawn at 960 so labels are crisp at their real size, selected chips are a raised fill with a 3px lime bar, the plate is 60 px, the ascending here tag and the warning lose their outlines, and pack rows stretch to fill the list with even pitch.
now: The pre-raid page has crisp map names, calmer selected chips, an evenly spaced pack and a smaller ascend button.
